genxml.title: Bedrock internal crossbar (XB) registers outside the census
genxml.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
genxml.doc: The crossbar's 21 control, debug and error registers at the start of its block, the 14 error-clear registers and the first-error register. The census has only the block's row in the dump table. Names, offsets and field layouts come from the public Linux header; that header states no access direction, reset value or side effect, so every item is inferred and the reset values are unknown. Access is recorded as rw for the control and error registers, r for the first-error register and w for the clear registers: the first two are assumed from the header's wording, the first-error register is what the header says (not writable). Clear registers take the field layout of the register they clear. Bit positions are the little-endian layout the header gives first.

struct.name: XB_PARMS
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Crossbar-wide parameters. The header gives the bypass enable and three wrap periods (age, deadlock, tail). It does not say what the periods count or how the crossbar uses them.

struct.name: XB_SLOW_GNT
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Wavefront grant period per unit: the number of cycles between grant opportunities. The all-ones value gives no grants, and one less than all ones the slowest rate. Used to apply backpressure to a unit's output queues. Bypass grants are not affected.

struct.name: XB_SPEW_CONTROL
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Snoop selector for internal crossbar traffic, sent to the PI1 port. The header says only one selector should be set, and any set selector takes PI1 away from every use except this debug connection. Separate from the debug data select register.

struct.name: XB_IOQ_ARB_TRIGGER
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clocks the I/O output queue waits before crossbar arbitration starts, so the slower I/O data rate can catch up in the queue buffer.

struct.name: XB_POQ0_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the PI0 output queue. The header says software may write it to test error handling, and the write raises an interrupt.

struct.name: XB_PIQ0_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the PI0 input queue. The header says the processor-interface input cannot underflow, so no underflow field is defined.

struct.name: XB_POQ1_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the PI1 output queue. The header gives no field layout for it.

struct.name: XB_PIQ1_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the PI1 input queue. The header gives no field layout for it.

struct.name: XB_MP0_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the memory-to-PI0 output queue. The header notes the crossbar select is decoded on the memory side of this queue, so no invalid-select field is defined.

struct.name: XB_MP1_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the memory-to-PI1 output queue. The header gives no field layout for it.

struct.name: XB_MMQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the memory output queue that carries miscellaneous traffic to LB, NI and II. The header gives no field layout for it.

struct.name: XB_MIQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the memory input queue. The header says further errors of this queue are logged in the memory unit's input error registers.

struct.name: XB_NOQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the NI output queue. The header defines three separate 4-bit counters for it.

struct.name: XB_NIQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the NI input queue. The header gives no field layout for it.

struct.name: XB_IOQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the I/O output queue. The header gives no field layout for it.

struct.name: XB_IIQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the I/O input queue. The header gives no field layout for it.

struct.name: XB_LOQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the LB output queue.

struct.name: XB_LIQ_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Error record for the LB input queue. The header says it records only request-channel errors: the reply channel has no flow control and cannot overflow or deadlock.

struct.name: XB_FIRST_ERROR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: The first crossbar error latched. It latches when the valid bit is clear and an error occurs. Any set valid bit interrupts both processor interfaces. The interrupt stays until the error register that captured the error is cleared, then this register is cleared, in that order. The header says the register is not writable but is set whenever software writes any error register.

struct.name: XB_DEBUG_DATA_CTL
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Selects which queue observation points drive debug output. The header says more than one selected point makes the debug output undefined. The output formats are not in the header.

struct.name: XB_DEBUG_ARB_CTL
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Three-bit select for the debug mux of the crossbar's queues and arbiter. The header does not give the output each value selects.

struct.name: XB_POQ0_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the PI0 output queue error record. The header does not say whether a write clears by any value or only by set bits, so the mechanism is unknown. Field layout as the base register.

struct.name: XB_PIQ0_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the PI0 input queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown; field layout as the base register.

struct.name: XB_POQ1_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the PI1 output queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_PIQ1_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the PI1 input queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_MP0_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the memory-to-PI0 output queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_MP1_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the memory-to-PI1 output queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_MMQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the memory output queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_MIQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the memory input queue error record. The header names this register with an extra XM_ in the macro, and its comment says it clears the MIQ error register. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_NOQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the NI output queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_NIQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the NI input queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_IOQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the I/O output queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_IIQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the I/O input queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_LOQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the LB output queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_LIQ_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the LB input queue error record. The write mechanism is unknown.

struct.name: XB_FIRST_ERROR_CLEAR
struct.from: Linux 2.5.40 public SN1 crossbar register header: register names, offsets and field layouts
struct.doc: Clears the first-error register. The header says it is cleared after the error register that captured the error. The write mechanism is unknown.
